# PrivacyFold — Zero-Upload Client-Side Utility & Built-In AI Platform
> 100% browser-local execution via WebAssembly, WebGPU, and W3C Built-In AI (`window.ai`). Zero files or text strings ever leave the user's device.

## Agent Surface (Two-Lane Zero-Worker Architecture)
- Schema Index: https://privacyfold.com/schemas/_index.json
- Changelog: https://privacyfold.com/changelog.json
- MCP Server Package: `npx @privacyfold/mcp`
- URL Fragment Contract: `https://privacyfold.com/tools/{tool_id}?mode=agent&preset={preset_id}&source=mcp#payload` (Sensitive payloads MUST be placed in `#fragment`, never in the query string.)

## Tools Catalog (72 Tools)
- **Passport & ID photo** (`passport_photo`): Crop and resize a photo to official passport, visa and ID sizes. Pick a country, line your face up with the guide, then download a print-ready image. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/photo/passport-photo-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/passport_photo`
- **Image compressor** (`image_compress`): Make photos and images smaller without uploading them. Choose a quality and size, and see the new file size before you download. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/image/image-compress-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/image_compress`
- **Photo metadata remover** (`exif_strip`): Photos can carry hidden details such as where and when they were taken. Remove them before you share a picture. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/image/exif-strip-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/exif_strip`
- **Link & text cleaner** (`clean_paste`): Paste text or links to remove tracking parameters (such as utm, fbclid and gclid), strip invisible characters, and optionally mask email addresses or secret keys. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/crypto/clean-paste-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/clean_paste`
- **Watermark & document stamp** (`stego_seal`): Add a visible status stamp (such as Confidential, Approved or Draft) to an image or document page, plus an optional embedded recipient ID. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/crypto/stego-seal-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/stego_seal`
- **Document & image compare** (`vellum_diff`): Overlay two versions of a document, contract or image to spot differences. Changed text, numbers or pixels are highlighted in red. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/pdf/vellum-diff-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/vellum_diff`
- **JSON formatter** (`json_format`): Check, tidy and minify JSON. The result updates as you type. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/json-format-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/json_format`
- **JWT decoder** (`jwt_decode`): Read what is inside a JSON Web Token. The signature is not checked, so do not treat a decoded token as trusted. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/jwt-decode-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/jwt_decode`
- **Base64 encoder and decoder** (`base64`): Convert text to Base64 and back. Handles any language and emoji. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/base64-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/base64`
- **Hash generator** (`hash_gen`): Create a SHA fingerprint of text or any file, to check that it has not changed. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/crypto/hash-gen-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/hash_gen`
- **UUID generator** (`uuid_gen`): Make random unique IDs in bulk, using your browser's secure random source. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/uuid-gen-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/uuid_gen`
- **Merge PDF** (`pdf_merge`): Combine multiple document sections or pages into a clean, metadata-free PDF file right in your browser. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/pdf/pdf-merge-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/pdf_merge`
- **Split PDF** (`pdf_split`): Extract specific pages or page ranges from a document into a separate clean PDF file. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/pdf/pdf-split-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/pdf_split`
- **Document & image redactor** (`pdf_redact`): Permanently black out or pixelate sensitive areas on a document scan or screenshot. Nothing can be recovered from the exported image. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/pdf/pdf-redact-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/pdf_redact`
- **W-9 form helper** (`w9_prep`): Prepare a clean IRS Form W-9 summary worksheet locally in your browser with formatted TIN/EIN and certification block. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/forms/w9-prep-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/w9_prep`
- **SA100 helper** (`sa100_prep`): Line up UK HMRC Self Assessment (SA100) income, expenses, and Personal Allowance figures before you file online. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/forms/sa100-prep-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/sa100_prep`
- **Image format converter & resizer** (`heic_to_jpg`): Open iPhone photos anywhere. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/image/heic-to-jpg-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/heic_to_jpg`
- **Signature cleaner** (`signature_clean`): Lift a signature off paper onto a clear background. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/photo/signature-clean-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/signature_clean`
- **Password-protect text** (`file_encrypt`): Encrypt sensitive notes, keys or JSON with a password using standard AES-256 encryption. Save as a standalone HTML file that can be unlocked offline in any browser. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/crypto/file-encrypt-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/file_encrypt`
- **Password & passphrase generator** (`password_gen`): Generate high-entropy random passwords or memorable multi-word XKCD passphrases using your browser’s cryptographic random source. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/crypto/password-gen-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/password_gen`
- **Cron expression explainer** (`cron_parser`): Parse cron schedule expressions into a clear, human-readable description and preview the upcoming execution times. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/cron-parser-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/cron_parser`
- **SVG optimizer & cleaner** (`svg_optimize`): Clean and minify SVG vector code by removing XML comments, editor metadata, empty groups, and redundant whitespace. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/image/svg-optimize-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/svg_optimize`
- **Color palette & contrast checker** (`color_contrast`): Check WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA accessibility contrast ratios between foreground and background colors, and convert between Hex and RGB. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/image/color-contrast-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/color_contrast`
- **Regex tester & explainer** (`regex_tester`): Test regular expressions with live match counts, captured groups, and character positions. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/regex-tester-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/regex_tester`
- **URL encoder, decoder & parser** (`url_codec`): Decode or encode URL strings and break down query parameters, host, path, and protocol. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/url-codec-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/url_codec`
- **Text & code diff checker** (`text_diff`): Compare two versions of text, configuration or code separated by --- to see added and removed lines. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/text-diff-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/text_diff`
- **CSV ↔ JSON converter** (`csv_json`): Convert CSV spreadsheets into structured JSON arrays, or convert JSON arrays back into CSV rows. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/csv-json-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/csv_json`
- **Markdown to HTML converter** (`markdown_prev`): Convert Markdown headings, lists, code blocks, and links into clean, semantic HTML markup. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/markdown-prev-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/markdown_prev`
- **User-Agent & browser inspector** (`ua_parser`): Inspect any User-Agent string to identify the browser family, rendering engine, operating system, and device type. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/ua-parser-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/ua_parser`
- **PDF to Word converter** (`pdf_to_word`): Convert PDF document pages and paragraphs into an editable Word-compatible document locally in your browser using pdf.js text extraction and RTF/DOCX structuring. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/pdf/pdf-to-word-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/pdf_to_word`
- **Word to PDF converter** (`word_to_pdf`): Convert Word document text, contracts, or manuscripts into a clean, print-ready PDF file locally without uploading to cloud servers. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/pdf/word-to-pdf-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/word_to_pdf`
- **Image to PDF converter** (`image_to_pdf`): Place one or more photos or scanned receipts onto a standard US Letter or A4 page with clean margins for instant printing or portal upload. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/pdf/image-to-pdf-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/image_to_pdf`

- **ADA & WCAG PDF accessibility checker** (`ada_pdf`): Check document structure against US ADA Title II/III, Section 508, and PDF/UA (ISO 14289) accessibility rules: document title, language tag, heading nesting, and image alt attributes. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/pdf/ada-check-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/ada_pdf`

[Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/generators/privacy-letter-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/privacy_letter`

[Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/crypto/email-header-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/email_header`
- **AI background remover** (`bg_remove`): Isolate portraits, signatures, or products onto a transparent PNG or studio backdrop locally using BEN v2 / MODNet via ONNX Runtime WebGPU (~120ms per photo). [Tier: M | Engine: /wasm/photo/bg-remove-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/bg_remove`
- **Object & watermark remover (Inpainting)** (`magic_eraser`): Remove unwanted objects, date stamps, or watermarks using fast-fourier convolution inpainting (LaMa-FP16-pruned ~38 MB on WebGPU) directly in your browser. [Tier: M | Engine: /wasm/image/magic-eraser-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/magic_eraser`
- **AI image upscaler & restorer** (`image_upscaler`): Upscale small or compressed photos by 2× with edge-preserving super-resolution (Real-ESRGAN-compact / OmniSR-nano ~18 MB on WebGPU). [Tier: M | Engine: /wasm/image/image-upscaler-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/image_upscaler`
- **AI Airlock (PII redactor & token restorer)** (`ai_airlock`): Detect personal data (names, emails, SSN/NINO, IBAN, credit cards, phones, API keys) on your device, replace them with tokens ([PERSON_1], [EMAIL_1]) before pasting into ChatGPT/Claude, and restore real values locally afterwards. [Tier: M | Engine: /wasm/crypto/ai-airlock-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/ai_airlock`
- **Exposure X-ray & redaction self-test** (`exposure_xray`): Drop any photo, PDF, or text snippet to see what it gives away: GPS pins, camera serials, timestamps, author history, and hidden PDF text layers—plus a Redaction Self-Test proving 0 hidden words are recoverable. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/crypto/exposure-xray-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/exposure_xray`
- **Fill from scan & local OCR** (`ocr_scan`): Extract text from scanned IDs, invoices, or payslips locally in your browser and map fields to W-9 or SA100 boxes with human confirmation. [Tier: M | Engine: /wasm/pdf/ocr-scan-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/ocr_scan`
- **Chat with PDF & document Q&A** (`chat_pdf`): Chunk document text in a Web Worker, compute local cosine-similarity embeddings (bge-micro ~22 MB + pdfjs-dist), and answer questions or summarize key points with 0 server uploads. [Tier: M | Engine: /wasm/pdf/chat-pdf-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/chat_pdf`
- **Zero-download AI writer & rewriter (0 MB)** (`ai_writer`): Uses your browser’s built-in local AI APIs (window.ai.languageModel, ai.rewriter, ai.summarizer — 0 MB download) with automatic fallback to SmolLM2-135M-Instruct (~45 MB) for grammar fixing, tone shifting, essays, cold emails, and video scripts. [Tier: B | Engine: /wasm/dev/ai-writer-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/ai_writer`
- **Speech-to-text & audio transcriber** (`voice_transcribe`): Transcribe English voice recordings 5× faster than real-time with Moonshine-tiny (~28 MB MIT ONNX) or Whisper-tiny, with Silero VAD silence trimming and SRT/VTT subtitle export. [Tier: M | Engine: /wasm/image/voice-transcribe-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/voice_transcribe`
- **Preset validator & compliance check** (`spot_rejection`): Verify whether an image or document looks consistent with published portal requirements (US State Dept, UK HMPO, EU Schengen, VFS Global) without modifying the file. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/photo/spot-rejection-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/spot_rejection`
- **QR code generator & Wi-Fi card** (`qr_tool`): Generate high-contrast QR codes for website links, Wi-Fi logins, or vCards locally with zero tracking redirects. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/image/qr-tool-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/qr_tool`
- **PGP / ECDSA armored message signer** (`pgp_crypto`): Sign cleartext messages using NIST P-256 / P-384 elliptic-curve keys in WebCrypto and output an ASCII-armored verification block. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/crypto/pgp-crypto-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/pgp_crypto`
- **Local SQL & table query runner** (`sqlite_viewer`): Run relational SQL projections and filters over local CSV or JSON datasets in browser memory. [Tier: D | Engine: /wasm/dev/sqlite-viewer-v1.wasm] -> `/tools/sqlite_viewer`
